scope: Controlled single-graph one-layer BF16 AFD FFN component experiment; one fixed2048-capacity graph per graph-executing GPU, resident inputs and one ordered device lane. Not full serving or best-tuned eager comparison.

hardware.placement: four FFN + four Attention on two separate four-GPU NVLink domains
hardware.network: single selected common RoCE rail per domain

method.captured_and_primed_graphs: one per source GPU in every variant; one per FFN GPU only in pooled_graph; zero timed recaptures
method.tuning_control: same fixed hint for all variants and live request sizes; exact eager is not retuned for each request, so this is not a best-tuned conventional eager comparison
method.correctness_case_count_evidence: derived from six explicit Request entries in hash-verified source plus successful completion metadata for each variant, not a separately emitted runtime counter
method.producer: all source payloads/routing GPU-resident before timing; all variants use identical matched source graphs and live token counts
method.timed: host enqueue plus periodic/full final completion drains; startup/capture/first replay and source generation excluded
method.queue: one ordered GPU lane with one reusable pool; configured window is a CPU enqueue limit, not measured in-flight occupancy or concurrent device lanes; actual queue occupancy was not measured; zero means final-only completion drain
method.pairing: same seeded changing request trace in each repeat across variants, queue windows and modes; per-repeat throughput ratio to exact eager retained
method.aggregation: median of three paired ratios is distinct from ratio of median throughputs; observed min/max ranges are not confidence intervals
method.event_gap: interval from previous request end event to next request start event; includes host window drains and excludes within-request gaps; role statistics are medians across ranks, never sums
method.enqueue: FFN host duration includes exact-eager blocking count reads and may include CUDA runtime queue backpressure; it is not pure CPU launch cost, and the cause of longer final-only-drain submissions is not isolated
method.memory: mean FFN per-rank peak minus corresponding pre-workspace baseline; allocated/reserved subtracted separately; resident inputs baseline and native transport excluded
method.cgroup: one representative per four-rank shared pod cgroup; copies never summed
method.artifact_collection: remote log files collected with zlib/base64 and decoded-byte length/SHA256 verification
method.host_metadata: source lengths and a common selected bucket are host-known; per-expert receive counts are produced on GPU and not known to pooled allocation
method.capture_scope: Complete one-layer FFN receive/count/pack/GEMM/activation/reduction/reply captured for pooled_graph; source communication graphed identically in every variant, source staging outside capture. Eager refers to FFN execution, not an entirely eager model. No full serving step measured.

limitations: Synthetic single-layer closed set of resident inputs; no model, scheduler, TTFT, online arrival process or cross-request device overlap.
Mixed source lengths and expert hot spots are seeded; only final timed output is checked, while a separate queued-burst test snapshots all outputs.
Transport and peer-wait tails can dominate throughput; queueing does not imply a consistent graph speedup.

matched_bucketed_control.scope: Separate matched-allocation hybrid final-only control, not part of the primary single-graph runs; bucket/capacity policy and DeepGEMM hint policy both change, so this does not isolate graph count alone or establish the cause of historical result differences.

profiling.scope: Separate Nsight Systems profiles: eight H100s, one max-capacity graph per graph role, hybrid/direct, 90 resident mixed requests, one repeat, matched graph sources, live GPU counts, one ordered lane and final drain only.
profiling.comparison: Controlled storage/count-sync/launch ablation: exact eager, fixed-capacity pooled eager, and the same pool with one graph. All variants use capacity2048 and common GEMM hint512; this is not a comparison against optimally tuned per-request eager kernels.
profiling.association: Same-thread host NVTX request range -> CUDA API calls -> GPU activity by (process, correlation ID). GPU work may execute after the host range closes.
profiling.aggregation: Medians across per-process requests (4 ranks x90 requests per role/variant); never sum across ranks. Stage medians need not sum to median exchange duration.
profiling.gap_definition: Positive holes between merged GPU kernel intervals of one request/process. Between-request gap uses all associated GPU activities, including staging copies.
profiling.mechanism_interpretation: Identical graph launches/geometry process changing GPU prefix sums. Persistent GEMM schedulers and activation loops skip unused reserved capacity. Per-expert128-row alignment and GEMM tile rounding remain; work does not scale linearly with live tokens.
profiling.counts_caveat: Per-expert numeric counts are not copied to host or recorded by the profiler. Local-zero inference is exact when all sources are empty or hot routing targets a different FFN. Global live source rows are not per-worker expert assignments.
profiling.timing_caveat: Profiles validate mechanisms; use separate unprofiled repeats for throughput. CUDA APIs overlap GPU work and kernel times can include peer/GIN completion waits.

zero_local_rows_inferred_from_hot_routin.explanation: All selected experts belong to another FFN; this worker has zero expert rows despite nonempty global traffic.

hybrid.tail_interpretation: Long source SendRequest/GIN completion waits coincide with FFN incoming/local-readiness waits. GEMM times and launch gaps remain ordinary. Underlying transport/progress cause is unresolved; these samples do not establish raw wire time, a CPU quota cause, or a graph-compute penalty.

figure_data.scope: H100 hybrid, single fixed-capacity graph, 90-request separate Nsight run
figure_data.gap_definition: Positive holes between merged GPU kernel intervals of one request and one process; between-request metric uses all correlated device activities including staging copies.
figure_data.limitations: Panel A is one observation per FFN GPU for each shown request; whiskers are rank range, not confidence intervals. Global input rows are not local expert-assignment counts. 128-row expert alignment/tile rounding remain. Profiling does not establish throughput.

long_single_graph_experiment.scope: Longer balanced fixed-capacity single-graph component experiment; every request, including all tails, retained. No serving or best-tuned eager claim.

method.variant_order: alternating two variants; each executes first twice
method.queue: final-only completion drain, one ordered device lane; actual in-flight occupancy not measured
method.full_trace: host-wall throughput includes all enqueue/completion work and tails; resident source generation and startup excluded
method.quarters: all four contiguous equal-request quarters retained; useful tokens divided by the maximum of four source-local GPU end-offset differences. GPU clocks/origins are not globally aligned; this is a completion-throughput variation diagnostic, not quarter host latency or global arrival throughput
method.tails: no outliers, warm-start portion or quarters discarded

representative_step_budget.scope: Paired representative hybrid request10 on FFN GPU0; fixed capacity2048/hint512 in all three variants; same source tensors/routing metadata, independently executed variants. Each timeline has its own local time origin.
representative_step_budget.selection: Uniform nonempty request minimizing summed relative distance to each variant median GPU interval, excluding intervals above3ms; request10 was selected from all90 requests.
representative_step_budget.unit: All raw segments are integer nanoseconds; table values are microseconds. 65us=0.065ms.
representative_step_budget.association: Host NVTX -> CUDA API correlation ID -> GPU activity; timestamp containment is not used.
representative_step_budget.partition: Activity durations are clipped only for tiny overlapping trace timestamps and otherwise assigned to the earlier-starting activity; positive uncovered intervals become device idle. Every partition sums exactly to first-activity start through last-activity end. Idle is exposed GPU idle, not a measurement of all CPU work.
